text:
```yaml
name: Nuitka Build and Scan

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y nuitka

  build:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Build with Nuitka
        run: |
          nuitka --standalone --include-package=dirsearch dirsearch.py

      - name: Rename output directory
        run: mv dist dirsearch-nuitka

  scan:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: grafana/shared-workflows/actions/dockerhub-login@dockerhub-login/v1.0.2

      - name: Scan Docker container
        uses: anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
        with:
          image: dirsearch-nuitka:latest
          fail-build: true
          severity-cutoff: MEDIUM
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a Linux environment using the `pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main` action, installs Nuitka, builds the project with Nuitka, renames the output directory to handle potential naming differences, and then scans the resulting Docker container for vulnerabilities using the `anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e` action. The workflow triggers on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
